ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
en: (2) By the clear Book,

ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
en: (3) Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night.[1459] Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
enNotes: [1459]- The Night of Decree (Qadr). See Sūrah al-Qadr.
tr: Innā anzalnāhu fī laylatim mubārakatin innā kunnā mundhirīn

ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
en: (4) Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct[1460] every precise matter -
enNotes: [1460]- Or "is separated" or "apportioned," from what is inscribed in the Preserved Slate. The angels record and descend with whatever Allāh has decreed for the coming year.

ar: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
en: (5) [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
tr: Amram min ʿindinā, innā kunnā mursilīn

ar: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (6) As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
en: (7) Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
tr: Rabbis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā, in kuntum mūqinīn

ar: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (8) There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
tr: Lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥyī wayumīt, rabbukum warabbu ābāʾikumul-awwalīn

ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
en: (9) But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (10) Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

ar: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (11) Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (12) [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (13) How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
tr: Annā lahumudh-dhikrā waqad jāʾahum rasūlum mubīn

ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
en: (14) Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
tr: Thumma tawallaw ʿanhu waqālū muʿallamum majnūn

ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
en: (15) Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
en: (16) The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
en: (17) And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
tr: Walaqad fatannā qablahum qawma firʿawna wajāʾahum rasūlun karīm

ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
en: (18) [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh.[1461] Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
tr: An addū ilayya ʿibādallāh, innī lakum rasūlun amīn

ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (19) And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
tr: Waʾal lā taʿlū ʿalallāh, innī ātīkum bisulṭānim mubīn

ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
en: (20) And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.[1462]
enNotes: [1462]- To death. Or "lest you assault me [with your tongues or harm me otherwise]."
tr: Waʾinnī ʿudhtu birabbī warabbikum an tarjumūn

ar: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
en: (21) But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
en: (22) And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
tr: Fadaʿā rabbahū anna hāʾulāʾi qawmum mujrimūn

ar: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
en: (23) [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
en: (24) And leave the sea in stillness.[1463] Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
enNotes: [1463]- After it has parted, in order that the soldiers of Pharaoh would follow the Children of Israel and be drowned.

ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
en: (25) How much they left behind of gardens and springs

ar: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
en: (26) And crops and noble sites

ar: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
en: (27) And comfort wherein they were amused.

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: (28) Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
en: (29) And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
tr: Famā bakat ʿalayhimus-samāʾu wal-arḍ, wamā kānū munẓarīn

ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
en: (30) And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
en: (31) From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
tr: Min firʿawn, innahū kāna ʿāliyam minal-musrifīn

ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (32) And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
en: (33) And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
tr: Waʾātaynāhum minal-āyāti mā fīhi balāʾum mubīn

ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
en: (34) Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
en: (35) "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
tr: In hiya illā mawtatunal-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīn

ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (36) Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
en: (37) Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ[1464] and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
tr: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaʿiw wal-ladhīna min qablihim, ahlaknāhum innahum kānū mujrimīn

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
en: (38) And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
tr: Wamā khalaqnas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīn

ar: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (39) We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
tr: Mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqqi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn

ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (40) Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: (41) The Day when no relation[1465] will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
enNotes: [1465]- i.e., patron, protector or close associate.
tr: Yawma lā yughnī mawlan ʿam mawlan shayʾaw walā hum yunṣarūn

ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (42) Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
en: (43) Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm

ar: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
en: (44) Is food for the sinful.

ar: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
en: (45) Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

ar: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
en: (46) Like the boiling of scalding water.

ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: (47) [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
en: (48) Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
tr: Thumma ṣubbū fawqa raʾsihī min ʿadhābil-ḥamīm

ar: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
en: (49) [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble![1466]
enNotes: [1466]- As he had claimed upon the earth. He is taunted with these words in Hell as a reminder and additional torment.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
en: (50) Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
tr: Inna hādhā mā kuntum bihī tamtarūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
en: (51) Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:

ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
en: (52) Within gardens and springs,

ar: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
en: (53) Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
en: (54) Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

ar: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
en: (55) They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: (56) They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
tr: Lā yadhūqūna fīhal-mawta illal-mawtatal-ūlā, wawaqāhum ʿadhābal-jaḥīm

ar: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
en: (57) As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (58) And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.

ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
en: (59) So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
